direction: I want to create a robot system that can handel transporting a container filled with fluid (to the brim). this system needs to be able to identify the state of the liquid, identify the properties of the liquid based on how it moves (traits like viscosity, etc to help with prediction), a model or some kind of predictor that takes in the current state, potentially a numerical fluid simulation formula (navier stokes equation) to find the optimal position and movement to transport the container object from one location to another. this means that the system needs to have a policy for grasping position and for movement and trajectory. it should be able to handle slight external force interruption to at least minimize the amount of spillage, and it  should also be able to identify close to spill or spill and stop, slow down, etc. this system is best if it is adaptable.

decisions.decision: MuJoCo is not installed in the provided environment and installing packages is not allowed, so the cart (a double integrator) and the reduced-order slosh model are integrated with a numpy RK4 integrator instead of MuJoCo. The physics of the brief is unchanged; the paper states this.

Compute budget forces reductions against the brief: 50 test episodes per run x 5 seeds (250 per condition) instead of 100 per seed; MLP encoder instead of GRU; one push magnitude in the main table with a 3-magnitude sweep for two systems; no separate lin2 (two linear modes) ground truth; sensor noise levels fixed (no per-unit-noise sweep).

rh check required method runs on every task label present in the registry, so the nominal-liquid push condition (already in sweep_push for 3 seeds) was added to the main group for all six systems and 5 seeds (109 s extra compute; total about 39 min). The derived-values row was re-logged under task nominal and the earlier row superseded.

Outcome is mixed and reported as such: learned MPC beats pendulum and single-mode spring-mass on nominal, but loses to two-mode spring-mass and ZV input shaping there; at tuned margins the pendulum spills less on held-out+push. No improve loop (quick profile).
